title: Super-intelligence or Superstition? Exploring Psychological Factors Influencing Belief in AI Predictions about Personal Behavior
summary: This paper explores psychological factors that influence people's belief in AI predictions about their personal behavior, questioning whether such beliefs are based on actual super-intelligence or are a form of superstition. It likely examines cognitive biases, trust in technology, and individual differences that shape acceptance of AI-generated insights.
highlights: Investigates psychological mechanisms behind trust in AI personal predictions
Contrasts rational assessment with superstitious thinking
Relevant to AI ethics and user acceptance
